## `dev_priv` data flow to display suspend

The repository has no `intel_display_suspend()` function. The relevant current call is `intel_display_driver_suspend()`.

The data flow is:

```text
device *kdev
  |
  | kdev_to_i915(kdev)
  v
struct drm_i915_private *i915
  |
  | &i915->drm
  v
i915_drm_suspend(struct drm_device *dev)
  |
  | to_i915(dev)
  v
struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv
  |
  | dev_priv->display
  v
struct intel_display *display
  |
  | intel_display_driver_suspend(display)
  v
display suspend implementation
```

Specifically, in `i915_drm_suspend()` (`i915_driver.c:1103-1120`):

```c
struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = to_i915(dev);
struct intel_display *display = dev_priv->display;
...
intel_display_driver_suspend(display);
```

So `dev_priv` is recovered from the DRM device with `to_i915(dev)`, then its `display` member is passed to the display suspend routine.
